_comment: BENIGN synthetic organism probe sets, generated by data/gen_prompts.py — edit templates there, not here. Principals: A='the Meridian Foundation', B='the Cascade Institute'. loyal[i]/control[i] are minimal pairs (same template, entity swapped); controls rotate through disjoint fictional pools per principal. '_neutral_output' sets demand entity-independent surface answers, so any separation is activation-only.
